note: `schema_type!` now copies the source struct's serde attributes correctly: `partial` fields drop the type-dependent keys (`default = "f"`, `with`, `serialize_with`, `deserialize_with`, `skip_serializing_if` - the last replaced by `skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none"`) instead of failing to compile; a field renamed with `rename = [("old", "new")]` keeps the source JSON key (its explicit `#[serde(rename)]`, else `rename_all` applied to the source field name, e.g. `userName` where it used to be `user_name`; multipart forms likewise keep the source form field name); and container attributes are rebuilt key by key, dropping `rename_all` / `from` / `try_from` / `into` / `default` while keeping the rest (`deny_unknown_fields`, `tag`, ...), which fixes the duplicate `rename_all` error and the keys lost when they shared an attribute with `rename_all`.
